# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=0.0323)

# Create the outer rectangle with rounded edges
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0517, 0.0).lineTo(0.6983, 0.0).threePointArc((0.75, 0.0517), (0.6983, 0.1034)).lineTo(0.0517, 0.1034).threePointArc((0.0, 0.0517), (0.0517, 0.0)).close()

# Create the first cylindrical hole

# Create the second cylindrical hole

# Create the inner circles for the holes

sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.6983, 0.0517).circle(0.013)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.75      # X length
W = 0.1034    # Y width (slot diameter)
T = 0.0324    # total height at ends
t = 0.02      # base plate thickness

r_end = W / 2.0
c_off = (L - W) / 2.0  # center offset of end arcs from middle

# Base plate (slot shape) - thin middle section
plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .slot2D(L, W, 0)
    .extrude(t)
)

# End bosses - full thickness rounded ends
boss = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints([(-c_off, 0), (c_off, 0)])
    .circle(r_end)
    .extrude(T)
)

part = plate.union(boss)

# Counterbored holes through both ends
part = (
    part.faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .pushPoints([(-c_off, 0), (c_off, 0)])
    .cboreHole(0.04, 0.064, 0.016)
)

r = part

import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
length = 0.7500          # X
width  = 0.1034          # Y (diameter of the rounded ends)
thick  = 0.0324          # Z

# Hole data (two identical holes at the rounded-end centers)
hole_spacing = length - width          # 0.6466
hole_dia     = 0.0252
cbore_dia    = 0.0460
cbore_depth  = 0.0100

# Base plate: oblong (slot) profile with semicircular ends
base = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .slot2D(length, width, 0)
        .extrude(thick))

# Counterbored through-holes at each end center
r = (base
     .faces(">Z")
     .workplane()
     .pushPoints([(-hole_spacing / 2, 0), (hole_spacing / 2, 0)])
     .cboreHole(hole_dia, cbore_dia, cbore_depth))
